BiblicalUsage: Quietness is what David trusted in too soon: in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved. The word is ease, rest, a settled life, and the verse is the confession of a man who mistook prosperity for permanence.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe prosperity is the hardest test of faith, for David said he would never be moved, and I hold that only the Lord is unmoveable.
